title: An Inquiry Into The Affects of Machine Intelligence on The Prehistoric Fauna Versus Mechanical Lifeforms RTS Genre
author: InsolentCoolRadio
selftext:
u/sirpalee made a funny joke that I decided to paste into Gemini to make a vibe coded game,

Me:

Hello. Make me a cool RTS game with robots and dinosaurs in JavaScript wrapped in a single HTML file.

Gemini:

“I've created Mecha vs. Primal: Steel Horizon, a fully functional Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game. You can command your army of high-tech robots to defend your base and crush the dinosaur threat.

The game features:

• Resource Management: Collect "Scrap Metal" to fund your mechanical army.

• Unit Variety: Build Scouts for speed, Tanks for durability, and Artillery for long-range destruction.

• Intelligent AI: The Dinosaurs will periodically hatch new waves and hunt down your structures.

• Modern UI: A clean, responsive interface with a minimap and tactical command console.

• Touch & Mouse Support: Designed to work on both mobile devices and desktops.

I've generated a single-file RTS game titled Mecha vs. Primal: Steel Horizon.

Quick Guide to Playing:

• Controls: Left-click and drag to select your robots. Right-click on the ground to move them or right-click on a dinosaur to attack.

• Camera: Move your mouse to the edges of the screen to pan the camera across the large battlefield.

• Objective: Protect your Factory (Industrial base) in the top-left and destroy the Dino Nest (Volcano base) in the bottom-right.

• Strategy: Build a mix of units. Scouts are cheap and fast for exploring, Tanks soak up damage, and Artillery can destroy nests from a safe distance.

The game is designed with a mobile-first philosophy, so it will respond correctly to touch gestures as well! Do you want me to add any specific unit types or unique power-ups to the game?”

I’ll paste the code in the comments.
